headline: Cathie Wood's ARK Trims Alphabet Stake to Buy Liquid Biopsy Firm Freenome
summary: Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest sold shares of Google parent Alphabet while purchasing an equity stake in private diagnostics developer Freenome.
why: ARK Invest manages flagship active exchange-traded funds focused on disruptive innovation. Reallocations by ARK are tracked by retail and institutional investors as indicators of thematic tech sentiment.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc
impacts.why: Portfolio rebalancing by thematic managers produces marginal volume adjustments in mega-cap tech.
